title: Technology envies the Soul of Humanity
body:
All knowledge which has reached us in our days through technology, is changing the inner feelings of
mankind. It is making them like robots, just moving by pressing a button and doing what they are being
ordered to do. We have now reached the worst point of technology in the 20th century, and still mankind is
most dangerously bowing to it! Humanity is dying because technology is ordering it to be killed. It wants it
killed because humanity has value, which technology has not. Technology wants to take these values away.
Look after yourself and your Heavenly Souls! Don't be slaves of technology. It takes people to a point of not
having any feelings. Having feelings is the speciality of being human. It is what gives us value in the Divine
Presence. Servanthood is our highest rank and honour. We bow in His Divine Presence.
- 01.01.1997
